title: AS2 compiler: comma operator (sequence expression) not supported
description:
Implemented AS2 comma operator (SequenceExpr): parser produces SequenceExpr for comma-separated expressions; compiler evaluates left-to-right, ActionPop on intermediates, keeps last value. For-loop multi-var init (var i=0,j=0) and comma update (i++,j++) also work.

Evidence: pnpm --filter @flash/core run test -- --run src/as2/__tests__/seqexpr.test.ts — 14 seqexpr tests pass; full @flash/core suite 4917 passed.
